action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal moves at depth 4 to identify the best candidates in a difficult endgame down material.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search; candidate_moves must be empty. We are down a rook for a knight, king on b1 is somewhat exposed to the d4 and h2 rooks. Need full-root coverage before selecting a candidate. Using half the node budget (3000) at depth 4 as instructed, leaving reserve for verification and comparison.
